- **Photo locations:** run an optional Cloud AI job from Library care to identify businesses and venues near your photos. Review an estimate, choose a photo or spending limit, and pay $5 per 1,000 checked photos from AI credit. Unused reserved credit is released when the job settles.
- **Photo info:** suggested locations include Google attribution and a Maps link. Only GPS coordinates and available accuracy are uploaded; photo files stay on your server. Owners can dismiss suggestions without changing recorded GPS data.
